string-array.name: whatsnew_1_2_0
string-array.item: A new design in six styles: Stickers, Solid, Banner, Tiles, Pills and Classic, your old look. Pick yours in Settings, in light, dark or true black.
Now playing: see what your PC is playing, with its cover, on Overview and in five new music standby faces.
Play, pause and skip from your phone in Local and Tailscale mode, when you allow it on your PC.
Standby faces can dim when idle or stay bright, and fill the whole screen. Choose both where you pick a face.
A short guide in setup and in Settings explains how SysWatch works and which connection suits you.
Opening a pairing link during setup now pairs straight away.

string-array.name: whatsnew_1_1_0
string-array.item: A new look: one clean panel, big readable numbers, your alert limits drawn on every gauge.
Pick your own accent colour, a light, dark or true black theme, and one of five Overview layouts, roomy or compact.
Choose which cards show on Overview and in what order.
24 standby faces, 16 instruments and 8 art, and four home screen widget looks.
Local mode: connect straight to your PC over Wi-Fi or Tailscale, instant and private.
The app now tells you when an update is ready.
Now in English, German, French, Spanish and Russian. More languages arrive by themselves, with no app update.

Your PC\'s gauges, on your phone
SysWatch shows your PC\'s live CPU, GPU, memory and network here, and tells you when one crosses a limit you set.

How SysWatch works, the connection types and their limits.
Two apps work together, one on each device.
The free desktop app, from syswatch.devlune.in, reads the CPU, GPU, memory, network, storage and battery and sends them out. It sits in the tray and can start with Windows.
This app shows the readings live, draws graphs, raises alerts, and runs standby faces and a widget.
Paired once with a 6-character code, shown as a QR code on the PC. No account.
Read only, except play, pause and skip for media in Local and Tailscale mode, when you allow it on your PC.
Three ways for the phone to reach the PC. Pick the one that fits where you use it.
Instant: every reading as it is taken.
No internet needed, nothing to sign up for.
Phone and PC must be on the same Wi-Fi. Guest Wi-Fi often keeps devices apart.
Windows Firewall asks once to allow SysWatch on private networks.
Not encrypted on your network, and the code is the only lock. Use it on networks you trust.
If the router gives the PC a new address, the phone finds it again by itself.
Readings, the phone\'s name and an install ID pass through DevLune\'s relay. Nothing is sold or used for ads.
About five minutes of setup, once.
Needs a Tailscale account and the Tailscale app on both PC and phone, signed in to the same account.
It uses the phone\'s only VPN slot, so it cannot run beside another VPN.

That code does not look right
It is 6 letters and numbers, shown in SysWatch on your PC. It never contains 0, 1, I or O.
That address does not look right
Type it the way your PC shows it, for example 192.168.1.5. No http and no port.
That port does not look right
Use the port shown on your PC. It is 47800 unless you changed it.
